column2: Cinematic realistic dark fantasy game environment concept art, wide establishing shot looking down into a colossal flooded stone well shaft. At the top a rotting wet wooden dock with mooring posts, coiled ropes, fishing nets, crates and a huge rusted iron anchor half buried in the planks; a spiral cast-iron and timber walkway with riveted railings winds down the wet basalt walls toward a dark glowing center far below where a giant cracked bronze bell hangs on chains. Cold blue-grey moonlight falling from the well opening as key light, warm amber fish-oil lanterns as point lights on the dock, layered volumetric height fog thin near camera and dense in the depths, drifting mist with soft edges, wet stone with moss and tide marks, physically based materials, sharp high detail textures, filmic color grading teal and amber, Unreal Engine 5 quality, no characters, no text, no UI
